# Pull request

## Change

Explain what a reader can now find, learn, or build.

## Sources and rights

Link to original creators. Confirm summaries and templates are original, or explain permission for reused material.

## Validation

- [ ] pnpm check passes.
- [ ] New external links were opened and support the descriptions.
- [ ] New documents are indexed.
- [ ] Existing entries were checked for duplicates.
- [ ] Claims are attributed; private information and third-party media are excluded.

## Remaining limitations

List material limitations, if any.
